newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch flower sales up, although Germany buys less.
newsitem.headline: Dutch flower sales up, although Germany buys less.

text.p: Turnover of Dutch flower exports climbed 8.6 percent to a total of six billion guilders over the last ten months, the Dutch Floricultural Export Council said in a statement.
In Jan-Oct, the cut plant and flowers export industry enjoyed strong demand, and the industry is on track to declare 1996 a record year, it added.

Despite the strong growth, Germany - traditionally the bigggest buyer for Dutch flowers - is buying less than it used to and in Jan-Oct German buyers purcahsed 63.9 million guilders' worth of flowers and plants, down 3 percent on this time last year.

But the shortfall has been made up by increased interest from other countreis. In particular, British buyers are showing greater interest, purchasing 38.8 million guilders of flowers and plants, up 12 percent.

Japanese importers have also been very active in the Dutch market, buying 16 percent more than they did in the same period this time last year, the council said. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
